title: The Joke
summary: Start: enter The Joke. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the interceptor sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The fort is painted as a patrol post. The guns are real. An interceptor shoots first. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Plywood Fort's shell. Black Sail heat rises. The fort is still plywood. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
